channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-stock-trading
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Zacks Stock Screener — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: US stock market screener that allows filtering stocks by market cap, sector, industry, and more.

item.title: When Genius Failed — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Roger Lowenstein, 2000 Lowenstein tells the story of Long-Term Capital Management, the hedge fund whose highly leveraged bets collapsed in 1998 and forced a Federal Reserve-organized rescue. It is a classic case study in leverage, model risk, and liquidity.

item.title: Wealth-Lab — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Strategy development and portfolio backtesting platform for stocks and futures, supporting no-code building blocks and C# strategies.

item.title: TrendSpider — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Charting and strategy-testing platform offering no-code backtesting of technical trading strategies on stocks and other markets.

item.title: Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Mark Minervini, 2013 Minervini presents his SEPA (Specific Entry Point Analysis) method for finding growth stocks before large price moves. The book covers stock selection, timing entries with chart patterns, and strict risk management to protect capital.

item.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Daniel Kahneman, 2011 Nobel laureate Kahneman describes the two systems of thinking behind human judgment and the biases they produce, such as overconfidence, anchoring, and loss aversion. It is a foundational text for behavioral finance.

item.title: The Thoughtful Investor — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Basant Maheshwari, 2014 Maheshwari, a renowned Indian investor, explains in his book topics of financial analysis, the analysis of individual sectors and the behavioral aspect of investing.

item.title: The New Market Wizards — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Jack D. Schwager, 1992 Jack Schwager interviews some of the most successful traders in the United States. Through these interviews, Schwager offers insight into the strategies, perspectives, and psychological insights of successful traders.

item.title: The Motley Fool Stock Advisor — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Stock Advisor is a premium service that provides stock picks, analysis, and market insights.

item.title: The Most Important Thing — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Howard Marks, 2011 In this book, Howard Marks summarizes investment insights from his client memos and explains his investment philosophy.

item.title: The Craft of Investing — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: John Train, 1994 In the book, Train outlines his key strategies and principles that have brought him success, addressing everything from the psychology of the market to practical portfolio management tips.

item.title: The Big Short — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Michael Lewis, 2010 Lewis follows the small group of investors who recognized the US housing bubble and bet against subprime mortgage bonds before the 2008 financial crisis. The book shows how the crisis built up inside the financial system.

item.title: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: John J. Murphy, 1999 Murphy's standard reference covers chart construction, trends, price patterns, moving averages, oscillators, and intermarket analysis. It is widely used as a core text for learning technical analysis.

item.title: Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Taiwan's principal securities exchange. Strong concentration in semiconductors and the electronics supply chain.

item.title: Stocktwits Trending — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Ranking of the most-discussed stocks on Stocktwits, ordered by its trending score.

item.title: Stockopedia — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Stock screener and research platform for UK, European, and international markets that scores every stock from 0 to 100 on quality, value, and momentum (StockRanks).

item.title: Shenzhen Stock Exchange (SZSE) — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Chinese exchange with emphasis on growth, technology, and small- to mid-cap companies.

item.title: Sharesight — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Portfolio tracker for stocks, ETFs, and funds across global markets that reports performance including dividends, currency effects, and tax.

item.title: Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Major mainland Chinese exchange, focused on large state-owned and industrial enterprises.

item.title: Saudi Exchange (Tadawul) — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: The main equity market of Saudi Arabia and the Gulf region, operated by Saudi Tadawul Group. Strong weighting in energy, petrochemicals, and banking.

item.title: SIX Swiss Exchange — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Switzerland’s principal exchange, known for stability and strong representation of financial and life-science firms.

item.title: SEC EDGAR Full-Text Search — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Official SEC search for company filings such as 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and proxy statements, with full-text search of filings since 2001.

item.title: SEC EDGAR APIs — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Free official JSON APIs from the U.S. SEC for company filing histories and XBRL financial statement data, no API key required.

item.title: Reuters — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Global news agency with fast, neutral coverage of markets, companies, and economies.

item.title: Reminiscences of a Stock Operator — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Edwin Lefèvre, 1923 A thinly fictionalized account of speculator Jesse Livermore's career, describing how he read the tape, followed trends, and managed risk. Generations of traders regard it as the classic text on speculation and trader psychology.

item.title: Oaktree - Memos from Howard Marks — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Free archive of Howard Marks' client memos since 1990 on market cycles, risk, and investor psychology.

item.title: MarketSurge Growth 250 — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Curated list of high-potential growth stocks from MarketSurge (formerly MarketSmith), available with a MarketSurge subscription.

item.title: MSCI - Markets in Motion — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Daily and monthly market reports plus research-based commentary on equity, multi-asset, and macroeconomic trends.

item.title: LSEG Data Library — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Python library for LSEG Workspace and Data Platform data, successor to the Eikon Data API.

item.title: Koyfin — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Market data and analytics platform with customizable dashboards, charts, fundamentals, and screening across stocks, ETFs, and macro data.

item.title: Investor.gov — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Official investor education site of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission covering investing basics, fees, and fraud prevention.

item.title: Investing Groups by Seeking Alpha — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Investing groups on Seeking Alpha that provide stock picks, analysis, and market insights.

item.title: Interactive Brokers API — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Trading and market data APIs (TWS API, Web API, FIX) for programmatic order execution and real-time and historical data across global stocks, options, futures, and forex.

item.title: GMO - Research Library — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Quarterly letters, 7-year asset class forecasts, and valuation-driven research from GMO.

item.title: Following the Trend — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Andreas F. Clenow, 2012 Clenow, a hedge fund manager, explains diversified trend following across futures markets in enough detail for readers to build their own strategy. He argues that position sizing and risk management matter more than entry and exit rules, and shows how such a strategy performed year by year.

item.title: Finbox — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Offers tools for financial analysis, valuation, and screening of stocks.

item.title: Financial Times — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: International business newspaper covering global markets, companies, and economic policy.

item.title: FRED API — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Free API from the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis for more than 800,000 US and international economic time series such as interest rates, inflation, and employment.

item.title: FRED — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis database of US and international economic time series, such as interest rates, inflation, employment, and money supply, with charting and downloads.

item.title: EODHD — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: EODHD offers APIs for real-time and historical stock data, fundamentals, forex, and cryptocurrency data.

item.title: Deutsche Börse Frankfurt — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Germany’s principal stock exchange (formerly Börse Frankfurt), operated by Deutsche Börse. Electronic trading is conducted via Deutsche Börse Xetra.

item.title: Damodaran on Valuation: Security Analysis for Investment and Corporate Finance — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Aswath Damodaran, 1994 Damodaran explains aspects of valuation, from the basics of estimating cash flows and discount rates to the principles for using multiples.

item.title: Common Stocks and Uncommon Profits — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Philip A. Fisher, 1958 This book is considered a classic of growth investing. Fisher, who taught investment courses at Stanford Graduate School of Business, explains his basic views and his approach to selecting stocks.

item.title: CNBC Stock Screener — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: US stock screener, part of the CNBC PRO subscription.

item.title: CME FedWatch Tool — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Shows market-implied probabilities of Federal Reserve rate changes at upcoming FOMC meetings, based on 30-Day Fed Funds futures prices.

item.title: Berkshire Hathaway Shareholder Letters — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Warren Buffett's annual letters to Berkshire Hathaway shareholders, freely available on the company website, covering investment strategy, capital allocation, and corporate culture.

item.title: Benzinga Pro — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Benzinga offers daily trade picks from professional day traders with on-demand support, as well as exclusive market-moving stories.

item.title: AAII Sentiment Survey — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Weekly survey of individual investors' bullish, neutral, and bearish outlook on the stock market for the next six months, published since 1987.

item.title: A Random Walk Down Wall Street — via awesome-stock-trading
item.description: Burton G. Malkiel, 1973 Malkiel argues that stock prices largely reflect available information and that most investors are better served by low-cost index funds than by stock picking or market timing. The book is a standard reference for the efficient market hypothesis and passive investing.
